title: NTU Team Builds Low-Power Chips That Run AI on Your Phone
summaryZh: 台大研發兩代節能晶片，讓AI直接在裝置上運作
summaryHi: NTU ने दो पीढ़ियों के कम बिजली वाले चिप बनाए, जिनसे AI सीधे फ़ोन और कारों पर चल सके।
summaryEs: La NTU crea dos generaciones de chips de bajo consumo para ejecutar IA en el propio dispositivo.
summaryJa: 台湾大学が端末上でAIを動かす省電力チップを2世代開発。
summaryKo: 대만대, 기기에서 직접 AI를 구동하는 저전력 칩 2세대 개발.
summaryEn: NTU researchers built two generations of energy-efficient chips that run generative AI directly on devices.
paragraphs: A research team at National Taiwan University (NTU) has developed two generations of energy-efficient processors designed to run generative AI directly on devices, the National Science and Technology Council (NSTC) announced on Wednesday.

Most generative AI services currently depend on remote data centers, which means a phone or car must send data over a network and wait for a response. Processing on the device itself, the NSTC said, allows robots, vehicles, smartphones and factory equipment to react quickly, protect users' privacy and keep working where connections are unreliable.

The project is led by Professor Yang Chia-hsiang of NTU's electrical engineering department, whose guiding principle is to compute only what is necessary and to move as little data as possible. The first chip, built on a 40-nanometer process, identifies the most important relationships in the data before doing any heavy calculation.

According to the council, it was the first reported processor able to speed up both the training and the use of Transformer models, the technology behind tools such as chatbots. The second chip simplifies training further and delivers 1.6 to 7.6 times the energy efficiency of comparable processors reported at the time.

The findings were presented at the IEEE Symposium on VLSI Technology and Circuits, a leading chip conference. A third chip, produced in October on a 16-nanometer process, aims to overcome memory limits.
A team at National Taiwan University has made two new computer chips. The chips help phones, cars and robots use AI. They use very little power.
Today, many AI tools need big computers far away. Your phone sends data over the internet and waits for an answer. These new chips let a device do the work by itself.
The team leader is Professor Yang Chia-hsiang. His idea is simple. The chip should only do the work it needs. It should also move less data.
The second chip is better than the first. It can do a lot of work with a small amount of power. This is good for batteries.
The team made a third chip in October. The government helps pay for the work.
sentZh: 台灣大學的一個團隊做出了兩款新的電腦晶片。
這些晶片幫助手機、汽車和機器人使用AI。
它們用的電非常少。
現在，很多AI工具需要遠方的大型電腦。
你的手機透過網路傳送資料，然後等待回答。
這些新晶片讓裝置可以自己完成工作。
團隊的負責人是楊家驤教授。
他的想法很簡單。
晶片應該只做需要做的工作。
它也應該少搬動資料。
第二款晶片比第一款更好。
它可以用很少的電完成很多工作。
這對電池很有好處。
這個團隊在10月做出了第三款晶片。
政府幫忙出錢支持這項工作。

paragraphs: Researchers at National Taiwan University (NTU) have developed two generations of computer chips that let phones, cars, robots and machines run generative AI on their own, Taiwan's National Science and Technology Council said on Wednesday.

Most AI tools today run in large data centers. A device has to send information over the internet and wait for a reply. Chips that work inside the device can respond faster, keep personal data private and still work when the connection is poor.

The team is led by Professor Yang Chia-hsiang from the electrical engineering department. He explained that the main idea is to calculate only what is necessary and to move less data around inside the chip. Moving data uses a lot of energy.

The first chip can both use and train an AI model, which the council says no earlier chip of its kind had done. The second chip is even more efficient. It does up to 7.6 times as much work per watt as similar chips reported at the time.
The results were presented at a major international chip conference in 2024 and 2025. A third chip, made with a more advanced process, was produced in October.
sentZh: 國科會週三表示，台灣大學的研究人員研發出兩代電腦晶片，讓手機、汽車、機器人和機器能自己執行生成式AI。
現在大多數AI工具都在大型資料中心運行。
裝置必須透過網路傳送資訊並等待回覆。
在裝置內部運作的晶片反應更快、能保護個人資料隱私，而且在連線不佳時仍能運作。
這個團隊由電機工程學系的楊家驤教授帶領。
他解釋說，主要的想法是只計算必要的部分，並減少晶片內部搬動的資料。
搬動資料會消耗很多能源。
第一款晶片既能使用AI模型，也能訓練AI模型，國科會說以前沒有同類晶片做到這一點。
第二款晶片的效率更高。
它每瓦特能完成的工作，最多是當時類似晶片的7.6倍。
這些成果在2024年和2025年的一場重要國際晶片會議上發表。
用更先進製程製造的第三款晶片，已在10月製造完成。

Most generative AI services currently depend on remote data centers, which means a phone or car must send data over a network and wait for a response. Processing on the device itself, the NSTC said, allows robots, vehicles, smartphones and factory equipment to react quickly, protect users' privacy and keep working where connections are unreliable.

The project is led by Professor Yang Chia-hsiang of NTU's electrical engineering department, whose guiding principle is to compute only what is necessary and to move as little data as possible. The first chip, built on a 40-nanometer process, identifies the most important relationships in the data before doing any heavy calculation.

According to the council, it was the first reported processor able to speed up both the training and the use of Transformer models, the technology behind tools such as chatbots. The second chip simplifies training further and delivers 1.6 to 7.6 times the energy efficiency of comparable processors reported at the time.

The findings were presented at the IEEE Symposium on VLSI Technology and Circuits, a leading chip conference. A third chip, produced in October on a 16-nanometer process, aims to overcome memory limits.
sentZh: 國科會週三宣布，台灣大學的研究團隊研發出兩代節能處理器，專為在裝置上直接執行生成式AI而設計。
目前大多數生成式AI服務都依賴遠端資料中心，這表示手機或汽車必須透過網路傳送資料並等待回應。
國科會表示，在裝置本身進行運算，能讓機器人、車輛、智慧型手機和工廠設備快速反應、保護使用者隱私，並在連線不穩的地方持續運作。
這項計畫由台大電機系的楊家驤教授主持，他的指導原則是只計算必要的部分，並盡量少搬動資料。
第一款晶片採用40奈米製程，會在進行大量計算之前，先找出資料中最重要的關係。
據國科會表示，這是首款被報導能同時加速Transformer模型訓練與使用的處理器，而Transformer正是聊天機器人等工具背後的技術。
第二款晶片進一步簡化訓練，能源效率是當時同類處理器的1.6到7.6倍。
這些研究成果在頂尖晶片會議「IEEE超大型積體電路技術與電路研討會」上發表。
第三款晶片已於10月以16奈米製程製造，目標是突破記憶體的限制。

paragraphs: Engineers at National Taiwan University (NTU) have unveiled two successive generations of low-power processors capable of running generative AI entirely on a device, according to a statement released on Wednesday by the National Science and Technology Council (NSTC).

The work addresses a growing bottleneck. Today's generative AI largely relies on distant data centers, so phones and vehicles must transmit data and await a reply. On-device processing, the council argued, enables robots, cars, handsets and industrial machinery to respond almost instantly, safeguard sensitive information and function even when connectivity is patchy.

Professor Yang Chia-hsiang, who heads the team, summed up its philosophy as computing only what is essential while minimising the movement of data, which consumes a disproportionate share of a chip's energy. Accordingly, the first-generation chip, fabricated on a 40-nanometer process, pinpoints the key relationships within data before committing to intensive computation.

The NSTC described it as the first reported learning processor able to accelerate both inference and training for Transformer models, the architecture underpinning modern chatbots. Its successor streamlines training still further, achieving between 1.6 and 7.6 times the efficiency of comparable processors published at the time.

Both designs were showcased at the prestigious IEEE Symposium on VLSI Technology and Circuits. A third chip, manufactured in October on a 16-nanometer process, is intended to ease memory bandwidth constraints.
sentZh: 根據國科會週三發布的聲明，台灣大學的工程師發表了連續兩代低功耗處理器，能完全在裝置上執行生成式AI。
這項研究針對的是一個日益嚴重的瓶頸。
如今的生成式AI大多依賴遙遠的資料中心，因此手機和車輛必須傳送資料並等待回覆。
國科會主張，裝置端運算能讓機器人、汽車、手機和工業機械幾乎即時反應、保護敏感資訊，即使連線時好時壞也能運作。
帶領團隊的楊家驤教授將其理念總結為：只計算必要的部分，同時盡量減少資料搬移，因為資料搬移會消耗晶片中不成比例的大量能源。
因此，以40奈米製程製造的第一代晶片，會在投入密集運算之前，先精準找出資料中的關鍵關係。
國科會形容，這是首款被報導能同時加速Transformer模型推論與訓練的學習型處理器，而Transformer正是現代聊天機器人的基礎架構。
其後繼晶片進一步精簡訓練，效率達到當時已發表同類處理器的1.6到7.6倍。
兩款設計都在享有盛譽的IEEE超大型積體電路技術與電路研討會上展示。
第三款晶片於10月以16奈米製程製造，目的在於緩解記憶體頻寬的限制。

paragraphs: A research group at National Taiwan University (NTU) has created two consecutive generations of energy-efficient processors that allow generative artificial intelligence to operate directly on devices rather than in the cloud, the National Science and Technology Council (NSTC) reported on Wednesday.

At present, the vast majority of generative AI applications are dependent on remote data centers, obliging smartphones and vehicles to transmit information and wait for a response. By contrast, on-device processing, the council maintained, permits robots, cars, phones and industrial equipment to react rapidly, preserve user privacy and remain operational in locations with unreliable connectivity.

The team, headed by Professor Yang Chia-hsiang, is guided by a deceptively simple principle: perform only the calculations that are strictly necessary and minimise data transfer, since moving data is a major source of energy consumption. Consistent with this approach, the first chip, built on a 40-nanometer process, identifies the crucial relationships in a dataset before undertaking any intensive computation.

The council asserted that this was the first documented processor capable of accelerating both the training and the deployment of Transformer models, the framework on which contemporary chatbots are built. The second generation simplifies training even further and attains up to 7.6 times the energy efficiency of equivalent processors reported at the time.

The findings were disseminated at a highly regarded international symposium on chip technology. A third prototype, fabricated in October using a 16-nanometer process, is designed to tackle limitations in memory bandwidth.
sentZh: 國科會週三報告指出，台灣大學的一個研究團隊打造出連續兩代節能處理器，讓生成式人工智慧能直接在裝置上運作，而不必依賴雲端。
目前，絕大多數生成式AI應用都依賴遠端資料中心，迫使智慧型手機和車輛必須傳送資訊並等待回應。
國科會堅稱，相比之下，裝置端運算能讓機器人、汽車、手機和工業設備迅速反應、保護使用者隱私，並在連線不可靠的地點維持運作。
由楊家驤教授帶領的團隊，遵循一個看似簡單的原則：只執行絕對必要的計算，並將資料傳輸降到最低，因為搬移資料是能源消耗的主要來源。
依照這個做法，採用40奈米製程的第一款晶片，會在進行任何密集運算之前，先找出資料集中的關鍵關係。
國科會斷言，這是第一款有紀錄可同時加速Transformer模型訓練與實際應用的處理器，而當代的聊天機器人正是建立在這個架構上。
第二代晶片進一步簡化訓練，能源效率最高可達當時同等處理器的7.6倍。
這些研究成果在一場備受推崇的國際晶片技術研討會上發表。
第三款原型晶片於10月以16奈米製程製造，旨在解決記憶體頻寬的限制。
